title: NASA OMNI2 Hourly Solar Wind and Dst Index
subtitle: Hourly solar wind, IMF and geomagnetic indices (Dst, Kp, AE), 1963-2026
description:
Hourly near-Earth solar wind plasma, interplanetary magnetic field and geomagnetic activity indices from NASA's OMNI2 low-resolution data set, converted to a single Parquet table for Dst (geomagnetic storm intensity) forecasting.

**Source:** NASA GSFC Space Physics Data Facility, OMNIWeb, https://spdf.gsfc.nasa.gov/pub/data/omni/low_res_omni/omni2_all_years.dat (source file dated 2026-10-30).

**Processing:** the 55 whitespace-separated words of each record were given descriptive column names, fill values (999.9, 9999, ...) were replaced with nulls, a `time` (UTC) column was added, and trailing all-fill rows after the last available Dst value were dropped. No interpolation or filtering was applied.

**Notes**
- 559,527 hourly rows, 1963-01-01 00:00 to 2026-10-30 14:00 UTC, no gaps in the time axis.
- `dst` is complete for the whole period; solar wind / IMF columns are only ~50-70% filled before 1995 and ~98-100% filled afterwards.
- `kp_x10` is Kp multiplied by 10 (e.g. 3+ = 33, 4- = 37).
- Recent Dst values are provisional/quick-look and may be revised by WDC Kyoto.
- Original column documentation is included as `omni2_format.txt`.

When using this data, please acknowledge NASA GSFC's Space Physics Data Facility OMNIWeb service and OMNI data (King & Papitashvili, 2005).
